capabilities.name: InitializeApp
capabilities.description: Create a Dockerized web/nextjs Application with standardized structure and Forge manifest.

capabilities.name: ProvisionEnvironment
capabilities.description: Converge a Docker Compose environment (web + optional postgres/redis) for an Application; idempotent and non-destructive.

capabilities.name: InstallDependencies
capabilities.description: Install application dependencies inside Docker (npm) and record a DependencyInstall Resource.

capabilities.name: RunDevServer
capabilities.description: Start, stop, or inspect the app dev server in Docker; records a DevServer Resource.

capabilities.name: Build
capabilities.description: Run a reproducible production build inside Docker and record a Build Resource.

capabilities.name: Test
capabilities.description: Run the test suite inside Docker (Vitest) and record a TestRun Resource.

capabilities.name: Lint
capabilities.description: Run ESLint inside Docker and record a CheckRun Resource.

capabilities.name: Inspect
capabilities.description: Return a compact structured view of an Application (app, resources, events, app-events, notifications, routes, scripts, docker, secrets, jobs, agent-runs, email, health).

capabilities.name: Verify
capabilities.description: Post-deploy contract smoke: read-only HTTP assertions that a deployed app honors the platform contracts it adopted (C6 health, C10 auth gates + /auth/config). Exits non-zero on any failed assertion.

capabilities.name: ExplainFailure
capabilities.description: Analyze a failed Build/TestRun/CheckRun (or a log path) and produce a compact Analysis Resource.

capabilities.name: GenerateFeaturePlan
capabilities.description: Produce a deterministic Plan (resources, files, capability sequence, validation, risks) for a Goal.

capabilities.name: SetSecret
capabilities.description: Store an encrypted secret (e.g. an API key) for an Application; injected into its runtime, never persisted in source.

capabilities.name: UnsetSecret
capabilities.description: Remove/revoke an encrypted secret from an Application's vault (idempotent). Never returns the value.

capabilities.name: ScheduleJob
capabilities.description: Register or remove a durable scheduled job (recurring cron/interval or one-shot) that calls back into the app.

capabilities.name: Deploy
capabilities.description: Zero-downtime deploy of the app’s production stack (start-first roll) and record a Deployment.

capabilities.name: Productionize
capabilities.description: Generate the app’s canonical production artifacts (standalone Dockerfile, compose.prod.yaml with Traefik/data-plane/DB, .env.prod.example); idempotent and digest-pinned.

capabilities.name: Release
capabilities.description: Run the full production deploy pipeline end-to-end, idempotently and fail-safe: publish/await the commit’s image, repin (C8), deploy (C7 + P14 drift gate), verify (C14). Resumable after a partial failure; leaves prod on the last-good version on any error.

capabilities.name: AgentRun
capabilities.description: Invoke a model with a system prompt + input + enforced output schema; return the parsed result and persist the run (AgentTask) and its result (Artifact).

capabilities.name: SendEmail
capabilities.description: Deliver a transactional email (inline subject+body or a built-in verify/reset template) via a C5-configured provider; persist the send (EmailDelivery) with a redacted recipient — no body/creds retained.

capabilities.name: SendMessage
capabilities.description: Send an outbound message AS a user through their connected provider (MVP: email via Google/Gmail using the C24 broker); persist the send (EmailDelivery, owner-scoped, redacted) and emit MessageSent/MessageFailed.

capabilities.name: SetupObservability
capabilities.description: Register the platform self-hosted Langfuse OTel stack: validate keys, probe endpoint, persist ObservabilityStack resource.

capabilities.name: ProvisionMonitoring
capabilities.description: Generate the canonical metrics+logging stack (collector, Loki, promtail, Prometheus, Grafana), deploy it, wait for health, and register the MonitoringStack resource.

capabilities.name: Eval
capabilities.description: Run an eval suite: drive a real model (Claude/GPT) as an MCP client against the app's tools, grade the trajectory (deterministic asserts + LLM-judge), and report a Langfuse dataset run.

capabilities.name: DeliveryCheck
capabilities.description: Guard every hop of the delivery pipeline (commit→tag→image→deploy→consumer-pin). Each failing check exits non-zero and names the specific artifact behind with a concrete remedy. Silence requires an explicit in-repo declaration with a reason.
